_comment: The ecosystems the pre-adoption catalog lookup (deps.dev) can query.
deps.dev has no fuzzy search, only exact lookups keyed by one of a fixed
set of system slugs, and it returns 404 for both an unknown package AND
an unknown system slug (verified 2026-09-02) -- so this closed list is
the only thing standing between a caller and a confusing 'not found'
for a slug deps.dev never supported in the first place.
Three places read this vocabulary: the backend allow-list
and this file. purl_type is what services.purl_build.build_purl needs
to construct the right pkg: prefix -- it matches slug everywhere except
go, whose purl type is golang.
